quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor materials capacity (release): BASF signed a Letter of Intent with Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) under which its Electronic Materials business is expanding the Kuanyin site in Taoyuan with additional production capacity for advanced semiconductor materials supporting chip technologies below 2 nanometers, enhanced quality analysis capabilities and an expanded Innovation Center; the company says the investment supports rising demand for high-purity specialty chemical formulations and strengthens local manufacturing, quality assurance and technical service for customers in Taiwan. No investment amount or timing is stated. BASF set the strategic base of its global Electronic Materials operations in Taiwan in 2025; the business supplies process chemicals and formulations to the semiconductor and display industries.
